title: "Gold Regime Monitor"

        <style>
          /* ── Bdgwtr-inspired palette ── */
          :root {
            --bw-navy:    #003366;
            --bw-slate:   #4A4A4A;
            --bw-gold:    #C9A84C;
            --bw-bg:      #F8F8F8;
            --bw-green:   #2E7D32;
            --bw-orange:  #E65100;
            --bw-red:     #B71C1C;
            --bw-white:   #FFFFFF;
          }

          body {
            background-color: var(--bw-bg);
            font-family: Georgia, serif;
            color: var(--bw-slate);
          }

          h1.title {
            color: var(--bw-navy);
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--bw-gold);
            padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
          }

          /* ── Regime banner ── */
          .regime-banner {
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
          }
          .regime-yield    { background-color: #E8F5E9; color: var(--bw-green);  border-left: 6px solid var(--bw-green);  }
          .regime-decoupled{ background-color: #FFF3E0; color: var(--bw-orange); border-left: 6px solid var(--bw-orange); }
          .regime-anomaly  { background-color: #FFEBEE; color: var(--bw-red);    border-left: 6px solid var(--bw-red);    }

          /* ── Metric cards ── */
          .metrics-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
          }
          .metric-card {
            background: var(--bw-white);
            border: 1px solid #DDD;
            border-top: 3px solid var(--bw-navy);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
          }
          .metric-label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            color: var(--bw-slate);
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
          }
          .metric-value {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--bw-navy);
          }
          .metric-arrow-up   { color: var(--bw-red);   }
          .metric-arrow-down { color: var(--bw-green); }
          .metric-neutral    { color: var(--bw-slate); }

          /* ── Snapshot table ── */
          .snapshot-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
          }
          .snapshot-table th {
            background-color: var(--bw-navy);
            color: var(--bw-white);
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: normal;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
          }
          .snapshot-table td {
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;

          }

            font-weight: bold;
            background-color: #F0F4F8;

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "English")

# ── Load & compute ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

panel <- read_parquet("data/macro_panel.parquet")

window <- 252
n      <- nrow(panel)

results <- map_dfr((window + 1):n, function(i) {
  fit <- lm(gold ~ yield, data = panel[(i - window):i, ])
  tibble(
    date  = panel$date[i],
    beta  = coef(fit)[2],
    r2    = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    resid = tail(residuals(fit), 1)
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    resid_mean = mean(resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    resid_sd   = sd(resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_score    = (resid - resid_mean) / resid_sd
  )

# ── Today's metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

today      <- tail(results, 1)
last_date  <- format(today$date, "%B %d, %Y")
z_today    <- round(today$z_score, 2)
beta_today <- round(today$beta, 1)
r2_today   <- round(today$r2, 3)
gold_today <- round(tail(panel$gold, 1), 1)
yield_today<- round(tail(panel$yield, 1), 2)

# ── Regime classification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

regime <- case_when(
  abs(z_today) > 2              ~ "anomaly",
  r2_today > 0.4 & beta_today < 0 ~ "yield",
  TRUE                           ~ "decoupled"
)

regime_label <- switch(regime,
  anomaly   = "🔴 Anomaly — Gold is operating outside its historical range relative to yields",
  yield     = "🟢 Yield-driven — The gold/yield relationship is currently active",
  decoupled = "🟠 Decoupled — Nominal yield has limited explanatory power over gold"
)

regime_class <- switch(regime,
  anomaly   = "regime-banner regime-anomaly",
  yield     = "regime-banner regime-yield",
  decoupled = "regime-banner regime-decoupled"
)

# ── Beta arrow ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

beta_prev  <- tail(results, 2)$beta[1]
beta_arrow <- case_when(
  beta_today > beta_prev ~ '<span class="metric-arrow-up">▲</span>',
  beta_today < beta_prev ~ '<span class="metric-arrow-down">▼</span>',
  TRUE                   ~ '<span class="metric-neutral">—</span>'
)

r2_prev  <- tail(results, 2)$r2[1]
r2_arrow <- case_when(
  r2_today > r2_prev ~ '<span class="metric-arrow-up">▲</span>',
  r2_today < r2_prev ~ '<span class="metric-arrow-down">▼</span>',
  TRUE               ~ '<span class="metric-neutral">—</span>'
)
```

```{r}
# ── Regime banner ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

div(class = regime_class,
  span(regime_label),
  span(style = "font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:normal;",
       paste("Last updated:", last_date))
) |> tagList() |> browsable()
```

```{r}
# ── Z-score chart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

plot_ly(results, x = ~date) |>
  add_lines(y = ~z_score,
            line = list(color = "#003366", width = 1.5),
            name = "Z-score") |>
  add_lines(y = rep(2,  nrow(results)), line = list(color = "#B71C1C", dash = "dash", width = 1), name = "+2σ") |>
  add_lines(y = rep(-2, nrow(results)), line = list(color = "#2E7D32", dash = "dash", width = 1), name = "-2σ") |>
  add_lines(y = rep(0,  nrow(results)), line = list(color = "#AAA",    dash = "dot",  width = 1), showlegend = FALSE) |>
  add_markers(x = today$date, y = z_today,
              marker = list(color = "#C9A84C", size = 10, symbol = "circle"),
              name = "Today") |>
  layout(
    title  = list(text = "Residual Z-score — 252-day rolling window", font = list(family = "Georgia", color = "#003366")),
    xaxis  = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis  = list(title = "Z-score", zeroline = FALSE),
    paper_bgcolor = "#F8F8F8",
    plot_bgcolor  = "#F8F8F8",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
    font   = list(family = "Georgia", color = "#4A4A4A")
  )
```

```{r}
# ── Metric cards + snapshot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

tagList(
  div(class = "metrics-row",
    div(class = "metric-card",
      div(class = "metric-label", "Rolling β (252d)"),
      div(class = "metric-value", beta_today)
    ),
    div(class = "metric-card",
      div(class = "metric-label", "Rolling R² (252d)"),
      div(class = "metric-value",
          HTML(paste0(r2_today, " ", r2_arrow)))
    )
  ),
  tags$table(class = "snapshot-table",
    tags$thead(
      tags$tr(
        tags$th("Date"), tags$th("Gold (USD/oz)"),
        tags$th("10Y Yield (%)"), tags$th("Z-score"), tags$th("Regime")
      )
    ),
    tags$tbody(
      map(seq(max(1, nrow(results)-4), nrow(results)), function(i) {
        r <- results[i, ]
        tags$tr(
          tags$td(format(r$date, "%Y-%m-%d")),
          tags$td(round(panel$gold[i + window], 1)),
          tags$td(round(panel$yield[i + window], 2)),
          tags$td(round(r$z_score, 2)),
          tags$td(case_when(
            abs(r$z_score) > 2              ~ "Anomaly",
            r$r2 > 0.4 & r$beta < 0         ~ "Yield-driven",
            TRUE                             ~ "Decoupled"
          ))
        )
      })
    )
  )
) |> browsable()
```
